doc.text: The marketing authorisation for losartan 50 mg film-coated tablets is suspended with immediate effect, after an out-of-specification impurity result.
The product information for clopidogrel 75 mg tablets is updated. A new warning on use with strong CYP2C19 inhibitors is added to section 4.5.
An inspection found that the site is not compliant with good manufacturing practice. Supply from Site 14 is under review.
Batch 22-117 of rosuvastatin 10 mg tablets is recalled after a dissolution result outside the limit.
This notice is retracted. Batch 22-117 was recalled in error and the recall no longer applies.
An inspection of Example Pharma, Plant 7 found that critical deficiencies in sterility assurance were observed. Products made at this site are affected.
